subject: Packaging guidance for Acme Analytics — Pro + Dedicated add-on question
messages:
From: Jake Morris <jake.morris@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging question — Pro vs Dedicated + bundling

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're evaluating Redwood for two product teams at Acme: one wants the Pro tier for bursty usage (analytics UX), the other would like Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput on nightly batch jobs.

Before we commit, a couple quick packaging questions:
- Can we mix Pro (usage-based) and Dedicated (reserved) under a single contract/PO?
- If we purchase Dedicated for one team and Pro for another, do you offer a unified discount or blended rate?
- What does bundling look like for the Optimize and Console add-ons? Are those per-seat, per-model, or account-wide?

Priya (copied) will handle procurement. We're aiming to decide by end of next week. Can you send the simplest path that minimizes up-front spend while giving us an upgrade path to full Dedicated later?

Thanks,
Jake
Head of Platform, Acme Analytics

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Jake Morris <jake.morris@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging question — Pro vs Dedicated + bundling

Hi Jake — great to hear from you and glad the demo was useful. Short answers up front, then proposed paths below. Attaching an updated pricing sheet and our standard terms for procurement.

High level:
- Yes, you can run Pro and Dedicated under one account/contract. Billing is separated by route but we can present a consolidated invoice and PO mapping.
- We offer blended discounts tied to committed spend or term length. Term commitments (12/24 months) and committed throughput for Dedicated are the main levers.
- Optimize is account-level (applies to token routing and batching heuristics) and is priced as a monthly add-on. Console retention/advanced tracing is billed per-seat for named admins.

Suggested starter path (minimizes up-front spend):
1) Start both teams on Pro for 60 days with a temporary dedicated pool credit: we can provide 100k token credits to simulate Dedicated performance for the batch team in a pilot.
2) If pilot shows Dedicated needs, convert the batch team to a 12-month Dedicated commitment with a 10% term discount; Pro team stays on usage-based pricing.
3) Add Optimize as an account-level add-on trial (30 days) at no charge during pilot; Console advanced tracing seats can be added later as named admins.

If you prefer to lock in a blended discount now, we can propose a commitment that covers expected annualized spend across both teams and apply a blended rate. That requires a rough forecast.

Next steps:
- If you want the low-risk starter path above I can send a mutual action plan and the pricing numbers for the pilot (credits, overage rates, and the conversion formula).
- If procurement needs PO language or a redline on terms, loop in procurement and I’ll connect you with our contracting lead.

Irene
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: pricing_sheet_v3.pdf; redwood_terms_v2.docx)

From: Jake Morris <jake.morris@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeanalytics.com>, procurement@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Tue, 05 May 2027 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging question — Pro vs Dedicated + bundling

Thanks, Irene. The starter path sounds reasonable. A few clarifying points from Priya's side:
- For the Dedicated conversion: is the 10% term discount applied to Dedicated list price only, or to the blended spend across the account?
- Can the Dedicated commitment be measured as a max sustained throughput (tokens/sec) instead of a flat $$ commit? Our ops team prefers throughput SLAs.
- For Console seats: do you charge per named seat or per admin seat with unlimited read-only viewers? We have ~6 engineers + 2 SREs who need write access during rollout.

Also: can you include any short-term promotional discount? We're evaluating three vendors and would like a 60–90 day promotional credit if we sign within two weeks.

Appreciate you moving fast on this.
Jake

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jake Morris <jake.morris@acmeanalytics.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pricing approval and discount request for Acme (internal)

Team — looping you in for discount approval and quick pricing input. Key asks from Acme: 1) 10% on Dedicated or blended? 2) throughput-based commitment allowed? 3) short-term promotional credit if they sign in 2 weeks.

Acme would start with a low-risk pilot (Pro + 100k Dedicated pilot credits). If pilot converts we expect a 12-month Dedicated commitment. They are a mid-market buyer but have two product teams and clear expansion potential.

Suggested internal response: authorize a 10% term discount on Dedicated if they commit to 12 months AND provide a one-time promotional credit of $5k if they sign within 14 days. Allow throughput-based SLOs but require clear conversion metric (average sustained tokens/sec over 7-day window) for the conversion clause. Console seats: charge per named admin seat; read-only viewers are free.

Rishi / Monica — can you confirm the dollar ceiling for promotional credits and whether we need CSM involvement for the sustained throughput SLA definition?

Thanks,
Irene

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jake Morris <jake.morris@acmeanalytics.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing approval and discount request for Acme (internal)

Irene — good summary. Approve as proposed with one tweak: promotional credit up to $7,500 (instead of $5k) to close within 14 days, but only applied to first invoice and not refundable. Dedicated term discount: 10% off Dedicated list price for 12-month commit. Blended discounts are negotiable but require a minimum committed spend threshold (we should surface that if they ask).

Throughput commitments: yes, we can accept tokens/sec as a metric but require the SLA to specify measurement windows and an agreed baseline for normal variance. Recommend CSM/solutions engineer involvement to define the conversion trigger and to run a short benchmarking window during pilot.

Monica — can you draft a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) that captures pilot credits, conversion metric, discounted pricing, trial for Optimize, and the $7.5k credit? Need it by EOD so we can send to Acme.

Rishi
Director, Revenue Operations

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Jake Morris <jake.morris@acmeanalytics.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeanalytics.com>, procurement@acmeanalytics.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging question — Pro vs Dedicated + bundling

Jake / Priya — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per internal approvals, here’s the proposed offer:

Offer summary (pilot -> conversion):
- Pilot: both teams on Pro for 60 days. We will provide 100k token Dedicated-performance credits for the batch team to emulate throughput characteristics. Optimize trial (30 days) and Console advanced tracing (2 named admin seats trial) included.
- Conversion: 12-month Dedicated commitment for batch team with 10% off Dedicated list price. Pro team remains usage-based.
- Promotional credit: $7,500 applied to first invoice if signed within 14 days.
- Measurement: Dedicated conversion will be triggered by average sustained tokens/sec over a 7-day window; our solutions engineer will propose baseline measurement and run a 3-day benchmarking during pilot.
- Console: charged per named admin seat; read-only viewers free.

Attached: mutual_action_plan_acme_v1.pdf (MAP), updated pricing_sheet_v3.pdf, redwood_terms_v2.docx. If this looks good I’ll schedule a 30-minute run-through with our Solutions Engineer to capture the benchmarking plan and lock dates.

Next steps: please confirm acceptance of the MAP and whether procurement wants any term redlines — I’ll route to contracts for a fast turnaround.

Best,
Irene
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
(Attachments: mutual_action_plan_acme_v1.pdf; pricing_sheet_v3.pdf; redwood_terms_v2.docx)
